Messages.Author: rob...@mindspring.com
Messages.Body:


Good questions.

Yes, you use the WEB FORM to enter events. It takes some getting used
to, but most have gotten the hang of it. I will approve them when I
see they're ready.

I will always take the Archon, if sent, and am happy to archive them
for you.

It is no longer mandatory to send Archons in unless they are
Qualifiers for Continental Championship events. It's nice to have
them should something go wrong with the upload. I can then fix the
problems and complete the event. Otherwise, all I can do is remove the
results, hope you see it and either write me about it or try to enter
the results again. I used to write the Organizer, but often there was
no email, or a got a bounce back.

If you look up a player who played in an event and they are not there,
it's very likely that ..... they aren't there. They don't exist.

IN the case of Bart de Nijs, I created an entry for him in the
registry yesterday and you can now see him and his events. I rarely
add new players because of the way the site works: There is only one
person who has access to a player record in the registry and that's
the player. I can't do anything with it once it's been created. I
can alter and edit tournament results, but nothing about the player's
profile.

The organizer of the tournament should make sure his players are a
part of the registry before they enter events. Ask the player to
input his info, or the Organizer can do it before entering an event.

You're duplicates will need to be fixed. I will merge your games and
then ask the Web Master to delete the duplicate record, since I
can't.

QUIRKS:

The site is an American one and doesn't like commas in the VP field.
Use a dot. If you use commas the whole event will miss-fire and it
has to be redone.

After you submit an event, should you see a list of vken numbers and
info that the event has been updated. If you see any other scripting
in there like "Name mismatch", or "Update...etc", or "Insert INFO in to
ratings....". Something very likely has gone wrong. Commas or
punctuation other than a dot in the form, missing fields...... who knows?

Write and tell me what happened. Or better yet. Send me the ARCHON
so I can fix it when I see it's broken.

Robyn Tatu
Vtesratings@(NoSpm)white-wolf.com
